265:t_2:62.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Yes. That is why $$ゲッター線$$ seek the strong.」

265:t_2:63.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Once every 12,000 years, the universe seeks to be reborn.」

265:t_2:64.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist... Those two energies clash...」

265:t_2:65.en:
$$早乙女$$
「The force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life in order to erase the force that seeks to exist.」

265:t_2:66.en:
$$早乙女$$
「That gives birth to $$バアル$$.」

265:t_2:67.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're saying the universe gives birth to $$バアル$$...!」

265:t_2:68.en:
$$ミチル$$
「But life does not perish... Through the blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire and radiance of the sun, it walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

265:t_2:69.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Tell me! What the hell do those words mean!?」

265:t_2:70.en:
$$早乙女$$
「You would bow your head to me? $$竜馬$$, is that the extent of the man you are?」

265:t_2:72.en:
$$武蔵$$
「$$シンカ$$ isn't something someone can teach you. Reach it through your own strength.」

265:t_2:73.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That suits me. If you're gonna put it that way, I'll commit myself.」

265:t_2:74.en:
$$武蔵$$
「That's the spirit. I'll be waiting, $$竜馬$$.」

265:t_2:75.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Those who open the door to $$シンカ$$ confront the universe's end... And that will become the power to overcome the true end that will one day come...」

265:t_2:77.en:
$$早乙女$$
「After repeating 12,000 years 10,000 times, the universe reaches its true end.」

265:t_2:78.en:
$$早乙女$$
「That is the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist stake everything as they clash...」

265:t_2:79.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It draws in every parallel world that exists.」

265:t_2:81.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Twelve thousand years, 10,000 times... That's 120 million years...」

265:t_2:82.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The power to overcome that is... the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... In other words, the power of gods...」

265:t_2:83.en:
$$早乙女$$
「The war between gods and demons... Between higher life-forms and $$バアル$$... That is the means to overcome the end...」

265:t_2:84.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A war between gods and demons... That's what the $$ミケーネ$$ gods spoke of...」

265:t_2:85.en:
$$早乙女$$
「But some have forgotten the mission of higher life-forms. They may be the true enemy...」

265:t_2:87.en:
$$早乙女$$
「$$竜馬$$. I will show you and your comrades a glimpse of the end.」

265:t_2:88.en:
$$武蔵$$
「Don't die, $$竜馬$$ of this world.」

265:t_3:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...The gate has just opened...」

265:t_3:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what could it be for...?」

265:t_3:10.en:
???
「Do not forget hope, cursed wanderer. Your journey's end is near.」

265:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What could it be for...?」

265:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! I was acting serious, quite unlike myself!」

265:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Since we don't even know what tomorrow will bring, I'll postpone the ace pilot celebration until next time.」

265:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But a dimensional merchant has backbone! Whatever the situation, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open!」

265:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then...! To your bright futures! Let's give it our all today, too... Business, business!」

266:t_000:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I've detected a force approaching along our course.」

266:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「It seems our long-awaited uninvited guests have arrived.」

266:t_001:0.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ has been confirmed.」

266:t_002:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We've been waiting for you, $$サイデリアル$$!」

266:t_002:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I never imagined the day would come when we'd say that.」

266:t_002:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They've brought battleships, too. It seems to be a fairly sizable force.」

266:t_002:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Let's hurry up and squeeze them for a way back to Earth.」

266:t_002:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「S-somehow... Our usual roles seem reversed.」

266:t_002:5.en:
$$葵$$
「That's fine. They've taken plenty from Earth.」

266:t_002:6.en:
$n
「Exactly. We don't need to hold back.」

266:t_002:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go all out, with all our grudges from Earth behind it.」

266:t_002:10.en:
$$ボス$$
「Here comes an even scarier face!」

266:t_002:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go, $$サイデリアル$$! You're gonna help us get back to Earth!」

266:t_003:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... This is... something much greater...」

266:t_004:0.en:
$$ミカ$$
「The dimensional boundary is rapidly distorting!」

266:t_004:1.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad! It's on the scale of a $$時空震動$$!」

266:t_004:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's happening at a time like this...!」

266:t_005:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s are fighting!?」
